title: Aft Fuselage Skin Panel — External Doubler Repair at a Longitudinal Seam

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: External doubler repair for cracking or corrosion at a longitudinal seam of the aft fuselage skin, covering the routed clean-up, the doubler layout and the repeat eddy current inspection it carries.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the hoop strength of an aft fuselage skin panel after cracking or corrosion has been cleaned up at or near a longitudinal seam, using an external doubler fastened to the surrounding structure.
sections.damage_assessment: Establish the extent of the damage by detailed visual inspection followed by an eddy current scan to a radius of at least 200 millimetres. Record whether the damage is at the seam, at a fastener hole or in open skin, because the doubler layout differs for each. Damage that crosses a frame station, that reaches the tail cone joint, or that lies inside the boundary of an existing repair, is outside the scope of this repair. Where corrosion is present, remove it by blending first and re-measure the remaining thickness before you size the doubler.
sections.repair_procedure: Rout the damaged material to a smooth oval with a minimum corner radius of 12 millimetres and blend the edges. Do a dye penetrant inspection of the routed edge and confirm that no indication remains. Set out the doubler footprint from the nearest frame and stringer using the layout on repair drawing RD-53-31-12-902. Cut the doubler from the stock given on sheet 1 and drill the fastener pattern using the doubler as a template. Deburr, apply the chromate-free surface protection to all new surfaces and let it cure. Where the repair crosses the skin panel fitting D5331120456283, add the local packer shown on sheet 2 so that the doubler sits flat. Install the doubler wet with sealant using rivets AES990489-7D on the two outer rows and the clip D5331127144257 at each stringer crossing. Restore the external finish to aerodynamic smoothness class B and re-apply the paint scheme. Where the cushioned clamp AES541346K1 was displaced to gain access, refit it to the original position.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is life limited to 12000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment. Do a repeat eddy current inspection of the doubler perimeter and of the routed edge every 3500 flight cycles. Any new indication inside the repair boundary makes the repair invalid and requires a new engineering assessment. Report the repair to Aeralis so that it is recorded against the aircraft and reflected in the aircraft structural repair record.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Cracks up to 25 millimetres in length that do not cross a fastener row, are not closer than 15 millimetres to a fastener centre, and do not cross a frame station. One crack per skin bay.

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows of 48 rivets AES990489-7D, 22 mm pitch, 16 mm edge distance, staggered
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is life limited to 12000 flight cycles; repeat eddy current inspection every 3500 flight cycles.
